control_description: Three policies approved (POL-02, POL-03, POL-04)
gap: Checklists and procedures not yet written

control_description: MFA for PMS administrators and manager mailboxes; PMS roles

gap: No approval record

control_description: Front desk staffed 24 hours; back office locked; network cabinet in the back office; vendor data centers covered by SOC 2
Cross-cut shredder; MSP wipes PCs
gap: No disposal records; paper card forms kept since 2021
remediation: Shred forms; disposal record for every device and batch (POL-04 4.9)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Firewall blocks inbound traffic; guest Wi-Fi separated; lock vendor tool set to manual start 2026-08-05

control_description: MSP antivirus on all 3 PCs

control_description: None beyond antivirus alerts

remediation: Weekly log review (POAM-009); EDR alerts

control_description: Incident log required by POL-03
gap: No incident records before 2026-08; process not yet used

control_description: Card compromise runbook with the MSP, insurer, and acquirer in the chain
gap: Not tested

evidence: PMS vendor SOC 2; backup job report
gap: Lock database restore never tested; no contingency plan
remediation: Restore test with the lock vendor; contingency plan (POAM-010)

control_description: None: the MSP changes firewall rules and PCs on phone requests

control_description: BIA completed; cyber liability insurance with a breach hotline
gap: No contingency plan or internet failover
remediation: Contingency plan; cellular failover router
